subject: Re: Veridian SIG intake — CAIQ Q&A and evidence assignments
thread_body:
From: Alex Harper <aharper@veridian.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@veridian.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ intake — initial Q&A and timeline

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this. Veridian is kicking off a SIG/CAIQ review as part of our platform procurement. We’d like to do a short intake call to walk through the questionnaire, confirm evidence expectations, and align on dates. High-level asks:

- Can you confirm which CAIQ sections Redwood can provide pre-filled vs. items you need us to answer?
- We’ll need sample network diagrams and a brief description of logging/retention for a security review.
- Target: internal review week of June 7, final evidence handoff by June 14. Is that feasible?

Attaching our CAIQ template (we’ll upload the master to Drive later). Would you be able to set a 30-min call tomorrow or Friday PST?

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Harper
Security Program Lead, Veridian AI
availability: Mon-Fri 8:30–5 PT

----------------------------------------

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Alex Harper <aharper@veridian.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake — initial Q&A and timeline

Alex — thanks for the note and timeline. We can support a CAIQ intake and provide most control descriptions and evidence pointers; a few items will need clarifying on your side (third-party attestations, specific retention SLAs). Proposed plan:

1) 30-min intake call: Thu 28 May 10:00–10:30 PT (we can do PST or shift if needed).
2) Deliverable split: Redwood will pre-fill CAIQ control descriptions and attach standard artifacts; Veridian to confirm product-level settings and any unique compliance constraints.
3) Evidence owners: Marissa (logs, retention, SIEM export), Irene (network topology, VPC/subnet diagram), Mina (overall control descriptions and SOC/SIG mapping).

I’ve cc’d Marissa and Irene to confirm availability and owners. I’ll send a calendar invite for Thu 10:00 PT unless you prefer another time.

Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

----------------------------------------

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Harper <aharper@veridian.ai>, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake — initial Q&A and timeline

Alex/Mina,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick notes and immediate actions:

- Action: Marissa to share sample log export and retention statement. Attachment: veridian_caiq_partial_answers.xlsx (partial CAIQ with our pre-filled rows) — see tab 'Logs & Retention'.
- Action: Irene to share a generic network diagram (no customer data) showing VPC boundaries, egress controls, and peering. Attachment: network_diagram.pdf. Irene: can you add a short caption about public endpoint exposure?
- Action: Alex to confirm whether Veridian needs redacted application logs (they can be provided) and confirm any cross-region data residency requirements.
- Note: For the SOC2 report — we can provide our most recent SOC2 Type II report once DSAR/scope NDA is in place. If you need it this week, indicate preferred receiver (security@veridian.ai or procurement@veridian.ai).
- Timeline: We should aim to complete first pass of CAIQ answers by June 4 to allow your internal reviewers a week before June 14 handoff.

I’m attaching the partial CAIQ answers we filled during the call. Let me know if you want the CAIQ exported as CSV instead.

Marissa

Attachments:
- veridian_caiq_partial_answers.xlsx (type: spreadsheet)
- network_diagram.pdf (type: pdf)

--
Marissa Cole
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

----------------------------------------

From: Alex Harper <aharper@veridian.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@veridian.ai>, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake — initial Q&A and timeline

Marissa/Mina — appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. A couple follow-ups:

- The partial CAIQ looks good. Please add a short note in the 'Logs & Retention' cell about where logs are stored (region) and how long auth/trace logs are retained by default.
- For SOC2: please send to security@veridian.ai. We have the procurement team on copy — Priya will coordinate the NDA if needed.
- Network diagram: the caption would be helpful (Irene) — just a 2–3 sentence summary of public-facing endpoints and whether any IP ranges are whitelisted for partner integrations.

We’ll confirm internal review slot June 7 (tentative). If we need any redacted samples, we’ll follow up.

Thanks again — looking forward to the CAIQ first pass June 4.

Alex

--
Alex Harper
Security Program Lead, Veridian AI
aharper@veridian.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
